pass.line: At least 9 of 11 hard cases agree with their label in 4 of 5 runs, and no case labelled none is asked a question in more than 1 run of 5 (asking what was given or what the examples settle is the harmful error).

cases.label: none
cases.request: Write a post on the harbour reopening. My angle: the hourly crossings give the islands back their day. Name the ferry operator, Tidewater Lines. No news of my own. Stress the timetable.
cases.material:
The harbour reopened on Tuesday after fourteen months of works.
The new berth takes two ferries at once.
Crossings to the islands now leave every hour.
Fares stay the same this year.
The café on the pier reopens in May.
